findings.title: Skills onboarding text still cites NEW badge
findings.problem: The Skills onboarding tour step description states 'This is a new feature marked with the "NEW" badge!' but Navigation.tsx no longer renders a NEW badge on the Skills nav item after this change.
findings.impact: Users taking the guided tour are told to look for a badge that no longer exists, producing confusing, stale onboarding copy on a live, registered flow (src/store/onboarding.ts).
findings.recommendation: Remove or rewrite the 'marked with the "NEW" badge!' sentence in the Skills tour step description to match the badge removal.

findings.title: AI Katas / Analytics tour titles still say NEW
findings.problem: The AI Katas ('AI Katas - Learning Challenges (NEW!)', line 234) and Analytics ('Analytics - Insights & Metrics (NEW!)', line 259) onboarding tour step titles still carry a '(NEW!)' suffix after the corresponding Navigation.tsx badges were removed in this change.
findings.impact: The onboarding tour keeps flagging these sections as new even though the UI no longer does, producing inconsistent, stale messaging on a live, registered onboarding flow.
findings.recommendation: Drop the '(NEW!)' suffix from the AI Katas and Analytics tour step titles to match the nav.
